table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Mfg_Cust_Code = (SELECT M.ShortName FROM Manufacturer M WHERE ManfCode=I.ManfCode),
	Dist_Code=ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(:as_distcode)))), ''),
	Mfg_loc = (SELECT M.AliasName FROM Manufacturer M WHERE ManfCode=I.ManfCode),
	Invoice_No = SL.SaleInvCode,
	Invoice_Date=Convert(varchar(10), SL.DATE, 103),
	Customer_Code  = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.AliasName)),
	Customer_Name = A.Name,
	Dist_Brick_Code = (SELECT AR.AreaCode FROM Area AR WHERE AR.AreaCode=C.AreaCode),
	Dist_Brick_Name = (SELECT AR.Name FROM Area AR WHERE AR.AreaCode=C.AreaCode),
	Mfg_Product_Code=I.Remarks,
	Product_Code=I.CustomICode,
	Dist_Team_Code = (SELECT SM.SalesManCode FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode=SL.SManCode),
	Dist_Team_Name = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode=SL.SManCode),
	Batch_No=SD.Batch, 
	Quantity=SD.LooseQty,
	TP_Rate = SD.SalePrice,
	Discount_Per = SD.DiscPerc,
	Mfg_Discount = SD.ClaimableDiscPerc,
	Dist_Discount = SD.DiscPerc,
	CustomerType = CC.Name,
	Bonus_Qty=SD.BonusQty
FROM
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Item I
WHERE
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.POSTED = 'Y' AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode) AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	SL.DATE BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
